_note: Plot boundaries come from the field partner. Until coords_status reads 'confirmed', every output describes a candidate plot.

en.source: Provisional. A conservative reading of the published range for tropical mangrove plantations. Do not quote as a settled figure until the foundation's review panel fixes it.

ko.source: 잠정값. 열대 맹그로브 조림지 흡수량 문헌 범위를 보수적으로 잡았다. 재단 검증위원회 확정 전까지 확정 수치로 인용하지 않는다.

dakope.note: Mangrove planting area. Search extent used while exact plot boundaries are outstanding.

dakope-demo.note: The two strongest greening cells found by 'greenproof scan', merged. Replace with the real planting boundary once it arrives.

sundarbans-control.note: Mature forest. If the classification rules are right, canopy should read high and flat with an evergreen result. An anomaly here means the rules are wrong, not the forest.

observation.season_note: Dry season only. The monsoon brings cloud, and high tides distort readings over tidal flats.
